title: drag-lint: Project Rules
summary: Right-click a project in the Project Manager to make it the active project and open its Lint Options tab in the drag-lint dock
intro: Read this when you want to review or change the lint rules of one project: in the Project Manager right-click the project and choose drag-lint: Project Rules..., which activates it and opens its Lint Options tab in the drag-lint dock. From the command line, drag-lint rules lists the whole rule catalog (not per project) and needs no index.

surfaces.caption: drag-lint: Project Rules
steps: Right-click the project and choose drag-lint: Project Rules...
The lint rule catalog is shown

surfaces.usage: drag-lint rules [--json] [--category <name>] [--standard cwe|cert|misra] [--rules-dir <dir>] [--target-compiler <ver|auto> [--project <.dproj>]] - list every lint rule (catalog; each labelled rule shows its CWE/CERT/MISRA ids, --json adds `compliance`; --standard lists only rules labelled under it)
help: drag-lint rules [--json] [--category <name>] [--standard cwe|cert|misra] [--rules-dir <dir>] [--target-compiler <ver|auto> [--project <.dproj>]]   - list every lint rule (catalog; each labelled rule shows its CWE/CERT/MISRA ids, --json adds `compliance` and needs_compiler / compat_since / target_active; --standard lists only rules labelled under it)
